recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for FHIR core. Any further SupplyDelivery event-pattern cleanup should be made in HL7/oo-incubator rather than in inactive core SupplyDelivery files.
issue_request: FHIR-12711 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Orders and Observations request to align SupplyDelivery with the Event pattern. The final Jira comment removed requester from the original list and requested basedOn, partOf, notDone/notDoneReason, occurrence[x], performer.onBehalfOf, quantity changes, and removal of the old subject shape; the resolution says the work was part of FHIR-10299 and preapplied.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-12711 was found. The historical application trail is the broader FHIR-10299 Event-pattern work: 5a6e321c64 reworked the SupplyDelivery spreadsheet on 2017-01-31 to add Event-style basedOn, partOf, status, suppliedItem.quantity, occurrence[x], and performer-like supplier content; aa45786302 added reusable Event-pattern extensions; and 1639b8d104 later updated OO event resources under FHIR-10299.
additional_context: SupplyDelivery is no longer active in FHIR core. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed supplydelivery=SupplyDelivery and related OO resources from source/fhir.ini and repointed core narrative pages to the OO Incubator IG. Current source/fhir.ini has no active SupplyDelivery resource entry, source/compartments.xml has no SupplyDelivery row, and current core pages link SupplyDelivery to build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator. Later related SupplyDelivery audits FHIR-37981 and FHIR-41414 are already present on the combined branch as external-repo decisions and explain the current receiver/subject model evolution.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. Editing inactive source/supplydelivery files would not affect the current FHIR core build, while the current OO Incubator StructureDefinition JSON already contains the substantive Event-pattern elements basedOn, partOf, subject, occurrence[x], suppliedItem.quantity, and supplier with later status/model evolution replacing the older notDone/notDoneReason and performer.onBehalfOf shape.
